newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P RATES AIG AUSTRALIAN UNIT'S CPA AAA.
newsitem.headline: S&P RATES AIG AUSTRALIAN UNIT'S CPA AAA.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said it had assigned an AAA claims-paying ability rating to American International Assurance Company (Australia) Ltd.
The rating is underpinned by the unit's financially strong and supportive parent, American International Group Inc, which is also rated AAA, S&P said.
S&P said AIAA is a niche life insurer with a general insurance operation, and has a dominant position in its chosen markets and a conservative financial structure.

The expansion of the AIAA business over time would reduce the significance of AIAA's moderating features, namely the company's limited size and growth potential in its current niche market, the rating agency said.
Management and operations were integrated with the AIG group and S&P believed it had the full financial backing and support of its parent, it said.
